def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    rows = [r for r in range(h) if 5 in grid[r]]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(h))]
    top, bottom = min(rows), max(rows)
    left, right = min(cols), max(cols)

    markers = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] not in (0, 5)]
    markers.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
    color_left, color_right = markers[0][2], markers[1][2]

    mid_r = (top + bottom) // 2
    mid_c = (left + right) // 2
    for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
        for c in range(left + 1, right):
            upper = r < mid_r
            left_half = c < mid_c
            out[r][c] = color_left if upper == left_half else color_right
    return out

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if 5 in grid[r]]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(h))]
    top, bottom = min(rows), max(rows)
    left, right = min(cols), max(cols)

    markers = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] not in (0, 5)]

    if markers[0][0] == markers[1][0]:  # markers aligned horizontally
        markers.sort(key=lambda item: item[1])
        left_color, right_color = markers[0][2], markers[1][2]
        direct_top = markers[0][0] < top
        for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
            upper = 2 * (r - top - 1) < bottom - top - 1
            for c in range(left + 1, right):
                left_half = 2 * (c - left - 1) < right - left - 1
                direct = upper == direct_top
                use_left = left_half if direct else not left_half
                out[r][c] = left_color if use_left else right_color
    else:  # markers aligned vertically
        markers.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
        top_color, bottom_color = markers[0][2], markers[1][2]
        direct_right = markers[0][1] > right
        for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
            upper = 2 * (r - top - 1) < bottom - top - 1
            for c in range(left + 1, right):
                right_half = 2 * (c - left - 1) >= right - left - 1
                direct = right_half == direct_right
                use_top = upper if direct else not upper
                out[r][c] = top_color if use_top else bottom_color
    return out
